## Review: knowledge-base (pass 2)

**What the branch does:** it adds two docs only, `specs/knowledge-base/design.md` (+206 lines) and `implementation-plan.md` (+251 lines). They plan a new migration that gives every uploaded file a source (`rag.sources`) with versions (`rag.source_versions`), kept up to date by triggers and changed only through `SECURITY DEFINER` version functions. Retrieval changes by one filter: it only reads `completed` versions, and `SchemaReady` gets a fourth column to probe. Each promised behaviour has a planned test in `supabase/rlstest/rag_test.go` or `internal/rag/retrieve_live_test.go`.
